content.text: Manual order fulfillment is a trap that most creators do not recognize until it breaks at exactly the wrong moment. It functions at five sales per month. It breaks when you are asleep and a buyer in a different timezone completes a purchase and waits eight hours for a download link that should have arrived in 30 seconds. It breaks when a webhook notification gets buried in your inbox. It breaks under volume in ways that destroy buyer trust that took months to build. The automated pipeline that COREMERCH deploys eliminates every manual step permanently. When a buyer pays in [[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/[[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/crypto-[[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/payment-infrastructure-south-asian-creators-minimum-viable-stack-2|COREMERCH guide to payment]]-gateways-digital-products-what-actually-how-13|Crypto Payment]]-payment-gateways-digital-products-what-actually-how-14|crypto]], NOWPayments detects the on-chain transaction and fires a webhook to your Cloudflare Worker or Google Apps Script endpoint. The backend verifies the transaction hash on the blockchain, logs the order to Supabase or Google Sheets, generates a receipt, and sends the delivery email via Resend or Gmail — all within 30 seconds of payment confirmation.
What This Actually Is and Why It Matters: Google apps

A sovereign digital commerce stack is a combination of free and paid tools that enable digital creators to operate a fully functional online store with automatic crypto payment processing, instant product delivery, and complete data ownership. This stack is crucial for creators in restricted countries, as it empowers them to monetize their digital products without relying on conventional payment platforms. By leveraging a sovereign stack, creators can ensure that their businesses are resilient to platform restrictions and currency fluctuations.
How the Architecture Works Under the Hood

The architecture of a sovereign digital commerce stack typically involves a frontend hosted on platforms like GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages, a backend logic handled by Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script, and order storage managed by Supabase or Google Sheets. The payment processing is facilitated by NOWPayments, which supports over 300 cryptocurrencies and charges a minimal fee of 0.5%. The webhook pipeline is triggered upon payment confirmation, enabling automatic order fulfillment and product delivery. This seamless integration ensures that orders are processed in under 30 seconds, providing a superior customer experience.
Who This Is Built For and Why

The sovereign digital commerce stack is designed for digital creators in countries where conventional payment platforms are unavailable or severely restricted. These creators produce a wide range of digital products, including ebooks, courses, templates, and software, but face significant challenges in collecting payments from their customers. By providing a reliable and efficient payment processing infrastructure, the sovereign stack empowers these creators to focus on their core business, expanding their customer base and increasing revenue. The stack is particularly useful for creators who require a high degree of control over their sales funnel and customer data.
The sovereign digital commerce stack provides a superior customer experience by automating the order fulfillment and product delivery process.
The Components That Make It Work Together

The components of a sovereign digital commerce stack work in harmony to provide a seamless customer experience. Cloudflare Workers, for instance, can handle up to 100,000 webhook events per day on the free tier, ensuring that the payment processing and order fulfillment pipeline is highly scalable. The Supabase database provides a robust and secure storage solution for customer orders, while Google Apps Script enables the implementation of custom logic and automation workflows. The NOWPayments gateway facilitates the payment processing, and the GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages hosting ensures that the storefront is always available and secure. The integration of these components enables creators to deploy a fully functional online store in a matter of hours.
